nodes.label: Invert audio toggle tooltip text
details: Corrected the audio toggle tooltip to describe the action (target state) rather than current state.
Tooltip now displays 'Switch to audio only' when in video mode and vice-versa.

nodes.label: Explorer Navigation Buttons
details: Added browser-style Back, Forward, and Reload buttons to the Explorer header bar.
Integrated webview history evaluation for standard browser navigation.
Refined Explorer bulge layout to accommodate new navigation controls on the left.
Used Material Symbols for consistent browser iconography.
